samples.gvd:
module asyn_fifo #(
    parameter DEPTH = 16,
    parameter WIDTH = 8,
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DEPTH)
) (
    input 					wclk,
    input 					rclk,
    input 					wrstn,
    input					rrstn,
    input 					winc,
    input 			 		rinc,
    input 		[WIDTH-1:0]	wdata,
    output wire				wfull,
    output wire				rempty,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0]	rdata
);

endmodule

module dual_port_RAM #(parameter DEPTH = 16,  parameter WIDTH = 8)
(
	 input wclk	,
	 input wenc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] waddr  ,
	 input [WIDTH-1:0] wdata ,
	 input rclk	,
	 input renc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] raddr ,
	 output reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata 		
);

reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM [0:DEPTH-1];

always @(posedge wclk) begin
	if(wenc)
		RAM_MEM[waddr] <= wdata;
end 

always @(posedge rclk) begin
	if(renc)
		rdata <= RAM_MEM[raddr];
end 

endmodule

<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO implementation with configurable parameters for depth and width.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Data input for writing.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Data output for reading.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">FIFO data width.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH">FIFO depth.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Combinational logic for generating wfull and rempty signals
        // Logic to compare wptr and rptr_syn to determine full and empty conditions
        // Additional logic for updating wptr and rptr_buff
        // Logic to update rdata based on rptr
    endlogic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic for updating wptr and rptr_buff
        // Sequential logic for updating waddr_bin and raddr_bin
        // Sequential logic for updating rdata
        
        // Dual-port RAM instantiation
        // Connect input and output ports to dual-port RAM module
        // Update wptr and rptr using XOR gates for Gray code conversion
        // Update wptr_buff and rptr_buff for synchronization purposes
        // Update wfull and rempty signals based on comparison results
    </implementation>
    
</module>
